mapper.select: SELECT ar.*, u1.username as applicant_username, u1.role as applicant_role_user, u2.username as reviewer_username, s.schedule_date, s.time_slot, d.name as doctor_name, d.title as doctor_title FROM application_request ar LEFT JOIN user u1 ON ar.applicant_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON ar.reviewer_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON ar.schedule_id = s.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON ar.doctor_id = d.id ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC

SELECT ar.id, ar.request_type as requestType, ar.applicant_id as applicantId, ar.applicant_role as applicantRole, ar.schedule_id as scheduleId, ar.change_type as changeType, ar.original_date as originalDate, ar.original_time_slot as originalTimeSlot, ar.new_date as newDate, ar.new_time_slot as newTimeSlot, ar.slot_adjustment as slotAdjustment, ar.doctor_id as doctorId, ar.field_name as fieldName, ar.old_value as oldValue, ar.new_value as newValue, ar.status, ar.reason, ar.reject_reason as rejectReason, ar.reviewer_id as reviewerId, ar.reviewed_at as reviewedAt, ar.created_at as createdAt, ar.updated_at as updatedAt, u1.username as applicantUsername, u2.username as reviewerUsername, d.name as doctorName, CASE ar.request_type WHEN 'SCHEDULE_CHANGE' THEN '调班申请' WHEN 'INFO_UPDATE' THEN '信息修改申请' ELSE ar.request_type END as requestTypeName, CASE ar.change_type WHEN 'CANCEL' THEN '取消排班' WHEN 'RESCHEDULE' THEN '改期' WHEN 'ADJUST_SLOTS' THEN '调整号源' ELSE ar.change_type END as changeTypeName, CASE ar.field_name WHEN 'name' THEN '姓名' WHEN 'title' THEN '职称' WHEN 'specialty' THEN '擅长领域' WHEN 'bio' THEN '个人简介' ELSE ar.field_name END as fieldNameDisplay, CASE ar.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '待审核' WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN '已批准' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '已拒绝' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' ELSE ar.status END as statusName FROM application_request ar LEFT JOIN user u1 ON ar.applicant_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON ar.reviewer_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON ar.doctor_id = d.id WHERE ar.id = #{id}
